> [!IMPORTANT]
> **This issue does not add the app to the directory.** Apps land only
> through a pull request that adds one file, `content/records/<slug>.md`
> (the record's fields as frontmatter, then the notes).
>
> The fastest path is the **[submission form](https://openappscout.com/submit)**:
> paste the GitHub URL, review the generated draft, and it opens the PR
> for you. Use this issue only if you cannot open a PR yourself — then a
> maintainer may pick it up when time allows, with no guarantee.

## 1. Basics

- **Name:**
- **Repository URL:** (the canonical `https://github.com/owner/repo`)
- **One-line description:**
- **Category:** (one of: `productivity`, `finance`, `education`, `tools`,
  `developer-tools`, `communication`, `health-and-fitness`, `business`,
  `games`, `media`, `entertainment`, `social-network`, `shopping`,
  `news-and-magazine` — see `data/taxonomy/categories.yml`)
- **Primary stack:** (e.g. `flutter`, `react-native`, `ios`, `android`,
  `kmp` — see `data/taxonomy/stacks.yml`)
- **Platforms:** (e.g. `ios`, `android`, `web`, `macos`, `windows`,
  `linux` — see `data/taxonomy/platforms.yml`)

## 2. Where to get it

Store or download links, one per line with the channel
(e.g. `play-store: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=…`):

-

## 3. Why it deserves a spot

A short paragraph — what makes it stand out, what it is good for, who
should look at it.

## 4. Caveats

Anything we should know about: license quirks, maintenance status,
paid-only features, etc.

## 5. Checklist

- [ ] The repo is **public** on GitHub
- [ ] It is **open source** under a verifiable license
- [ ] It has been **maintained** in the last 12 months
- [ ] I understand this issue is a suggestion, and the app is added only
      via a pull request
